verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only general CUDA/DLSS/RTX marketing docs and community reviews about pricing, power connectors, and performance-per-watt — nothing documents Linux driver releases, Linux-specific release notes, or independent Linux benchmarking/testing of the RTX 5090. Missing for 10: Linux driver release notes/changelog, Linux-specific performance/compatibility reviews, any mention of open-source or proprietary Linux driver support for this card.
